title: F126.3.3 the page a conversation names: a live play
caption: One conversation that names the page /, played live. The run asks the site for the page, keeps it under the play's trial, and sends it with the first ask and no later one. On a replay the page comes from the store and the route is never called.

steps.text: the page is rendered once, then read: title, words, places, links, focus
the page, or it throws and the run stops with the address

the stream of the second turn
